task_text: IKEA MuJoCo VARIERA shelf insert (IKEA VARIERA shelf insert (AA-741461-4), step 1) with two 7-DoF Franka Panda arms, each with the MuJoCo Menagerie Panda hand (two-finger, tendon-coupled). Assemble the VARIERA shelf insert: place the two side frames, lower the shelf onto them, and drive the four screws through the shelf holes into the frames' receivers until they seat. Success requirements: Four distinct receivers each hold a screw that was turned relative to that receiver (at least 0.4 measured turns, with a descent matching turns x pitch), its head seated at the shelf hole (axial 0.2 mm, lateral 0.6 mm, axis 1.5 degrees). The frames are aligned under the shelf, parts are slower than 0.02 m/s, the assembly stands on the bench on its own, and no robot touches any furniture part. All of the above hold for 0.5 s. The benchmark's terminal rules, the same in every IKEA MuJoCo task, come on top of these requirements. When your rows end: (1) the requirements above hold; (2) the parts are released: no robot link touches any part; (3) every part is at rest: at most 0.01 m/s and 0.05 rad/s; (4) the simulation never broke down: no non-finite state, no MuJoCo BADQACC / BADQPOS / BADQVEL warning, no contact of a part deeper than 10 mm, at any time. The grader then holds your last row for 1.0 s more and requires (1)-(4) again at its end. Mechanism: Screw threads and receivers are non-convex SDF meshes (0.5 mm pitch, right-hand): a screw advances only by being turned. There are no welds or other non-contact mechanisms.
